Basic chat completion against real OpenAI API

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { Message, createClient } from "@xberg-io/liter-llm";
async function main() {
  const client = createClient("your-api-key");
  const result = await client.chat({ maxTokens: 10, messages: [{ role: "user", user: { content: "Say hello in exactly one word." } } as Message], model: "openai/gpt-4o-mini" });
  console.log(result.choices);
  console.log(result.usage);
}

void main();
```
